assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The symptoms are clinically consistent with their known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The condition is coded as I34.0
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is ordered
The monitoring study is coded as CPT 93226
The study is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The study is medically necessary to identify the suspected arrhythmia
